purpose: Independent synthetic verification of the NeoPZ mixed operator and exact essential normal-flux elimination; no reservoir data modified

cases.method: Classical conforming NeoPZ RT0/P0 mixed Darcy
cases.hdiv_family: EHDivConstant, polynomial order zero; three triangular flux functions and one constant pressure
cases.dirichlet: p=1 at y=0 and p=0 at y=2200, natural mixed functional
cases.neumann: q dot n=0 at x=0 and x=1200, exact flux-coefficient elimination; no penalty
cases.material_integration: Each triangle lies in one constant-coefficient region; quadratic RT0 mass is integrated exactly
cases.solver: Intel MKL PARDISO through pypardiso; native NeoPZ element assembly and field evaluation
cases.linear_solver_coordinate_scaling: Eight symmetric Ruiz equilibration steps, final residual in unscaled physical equations
cases.timing_scope: Observed wall time without exclusive access; not a performance benchmark
cases.comparison: Native flux evaluated at all triangle vertices; pressure compared with exact triangle mean because the discrete pressure is P0
